info.name: Multi-Agent SQL Analytics API
info.description:
Postman collection for the Multi-Agent SQL Analytics backend.

## Base URL
Set the `base_url` collection variable. Defaults to the live deployment
`https://arshman.techquest.ai`. For local testing use `http://localhost:8010`.

## Authentication
Most endpoints require a Bearer JWT. Run **Auth > Login** first — its test
script automatically stores the returned token in the `access_token` collection
variable, which every protected request then sends via the
`Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}` header. `Health` is public (used by the
CD health check) and needs no token.

## Streaming (SSE)
`/query` and `/compare` return `text/event-stream` (Server-Sent Events). Postman
shows the streamed events in the response body as they arrive. Each line is
prefixed with `data: ` and contains a JSON event object.

request.description: Liveness probe. Public (no auth). Returns `{ "status": "ok", "ts": <epoch> }`. Used by the GitHub Actions CD health check.

exec: // Capture the access token so protected requests can reuse it.

request.description: Exchange username/password for a JWT access token. The test script stores `access_token` automatically. Returns `{ "access_token": "...", "token_type": "bearer", "expires_in": <seconds> }`.
Return the identity encoded in the current bearer token. Useful to verify the token is valid and not expired.

Run the full multi-agent pipeline for a natural-language request and stream progress as SSE.

Events (in order): `planning_started`, `domains_identified`, `planning_complete`, per-task `task_started`/`task_complete`, `synthesis_started`, `synthesis_complete` (contains the final `answer`, `charts`, and `stats`). On failure an `error` event is sent. Requires auth.

Run the same query through the baseline (no Blackboard) and improved (deduplicated) architectures and stream a comparison.

mode: 1 = SQLite native speed (0ms latency), 2 = simulated production DB (250ms latency, dedup wins), 3 = 250ms + warm cache (cache dominates).

Streams `compare_status` progress events then a final `comparison_complete` event with `baseline`, `improved`, and `delta` (db_calls/schema_tokens saved, time diff, winner). Requires auth.
Trigger a FAISS schema-index rebuild in a background thread. Returns immediately with `{ "status": "index rebuild started" }`. Run this after changing the schema definitions. Requires auth.
